levels.name: FLAG_OFF
levels.trigger: flag unexpectedly ON or any threshold breach
levels.procedure: set Stage 1 flag OFF; verify effective selected traffic stops
levels.verification: flag OFF; selected count stops; primary unaffected
levels.recovery_criteria: critical counters stable at zero and manual reapproval

levels.name: LANE_KILL_SWITCH
levels.verification: affected lane submissions stop; other lane and primary intact
levels.recovery_criteria: root cause corrected and lane approval renewed

levels.name: GLOBAL_SHADOW_DISABLE
levels.verification: all shadow submissions stop and effective traffic is 0
levels.recovery_criteria: incident closed and six approvals renewed

levels.name: CONFIG_ROLLBACK
levels.verification: configuration digest restored; flag remains OFF

levels.name: DEPLOYMENT_ROLLBACK
levels.procedure: roll back isolated non-production deployment image
levels.verification: previous image digest active; no shadow execution

levels.name: CREDENTIAL_REVOKE
levels.procedure: revoke workload credential and invalidate leases
levels.recovery_criteria: new short-lived credential approved after security review

levels.name: NETWORK_ROUTE_REVOKE
levels.trigger: production route detection or network policy failure
levels.procedure: remove route and deny egress at network boundary
levels.verification: route unreachable; production detection remains zero
levels.recovery_criteria: network drill passes and SC reauthorizes
